newsitem.title: Malta: Malta government revenue down in first five months.
newsitem.headline: Malta government revenue down in first five months.

text.p: drop in ordinary revenue and an increase in recurrent expenditure in the first five months of this year, according to official figures published in the Government Gazette.
Ordinary revenue compared to the first five months of 1996 dropped by 2.2 million Maltese pounds ($848,000) to 180.7 million pounds.
The government borrowed 72.4 million pounds during the period, compared to 20.7 million pounds in the same five months the year before. Grants dropped by 1.3 million pounds to 4.83 million pounds.
Recurrent expenditure rose by 5.2 million pounds to 206.8 million pounds, the biggest increase being of 3.9 million in public debt servicing, which rose to 12.8 million pounds.
Capital expenditure dropped by 6.3 million pounds to 24.6 million pounds. ($ = 2.592 Maltese pounds)
